_nguon: Bản phủ tiếng Anh của tuvi_kb.json (QTE-1 tuần 5) — chỉ mục chinh_tinh (14 chính tinh), cùng khoá. Chuyển ngữ máy theo bảng thuật ngữ thuat_ngu_en.json, qua bộ kiểm app/chuyen_ngu/kiem.py; chờ người bản xứ duyệt.

Tử Vi.tinh_chat: the Emperor star: self-respecting, wants to lead, likes order and to be respected
Tử Vi.diem_manh: steps up to carry the load, organises, keeps standards
Tử Vi.mat_toi: can feel lonely at the top, proud, slow to take feedback
Tử Vi.cau_tu_soi: Do you let others see when you need help?

Thiên Cơ.tinh_chat: the Strategist star: quick-witted, loves planning, often changes the plan
Thiên Cơ.mat_toi: thinks more than acts, worries ahead, wavers
Thiên Cơ.cau_tu_soi: Which plan have you thought through but not yet started?

Thái Dương.tinh_chat: the Sun star: generous, outgoing, likes to give and to be seen
Thái Dương.mat_toi: gives more than they can afford, burns out, seeks recognition
Thái Dương.cau_tu_soi: Are you giving more than you can keep up?

Vũ Khúc.tinh_chat: the Wealth star: decisive, practical, good at managing money and resources
Vũ Khúc.diem_manh: disciplined, follows through, fair in dealings
Vũ Khúc.mat_toi: rigid, dry with feelings, can be lonely
Vũ Khúc.cau_tu_soi: Do the people close to you see your care, or only your worrying?

Thiên Đồng.tinh_chat: the Blessing star: easy-going, pleasant, enjoys comfort and harmony
Thiên Đồng.mat_toi: avoids hard things, procrastinates, lacks drive
Thiên Đồng.cau_tu_soi: Which hard task are you leaving for tomorrow?

Liêm Trinh.tinh_chat: a star of principle and strong emotion, magnetic and ambitious
Liêm Trinh.diem_manh: upright once committed, persistent, able to organise
Liêm Trinh.cau_tu_soi: Which of your principles helps you, and which one binds you?

Thiên Phủ.tinh_chat: the Treasury star: steady, careful, good at keeping and saving
Thiên Phủ.mat_toi: conservative, avoids risk, too attached to safety
Thiên Phủ.cau_tu_soi: Which kind of safety are you holding on to that you no longer need?

Thái Âm.tinh_chat: the Moon star: refined, sensitive, inward-looking, saves quietly
Thái Âm.diem_manh: attentive, a good eye for beauty, patient
Thái Âm.mat_toi: emotional, keeps things inside, sad for no clear reason
Thái Âm.cau_tu_soi: Does what you are holding inside need to be said?

Tham Lang.tinh_chat: the Desire star: loves life, many talents, sociable, many wants
Tham Lang.diem_manh: flexible, attractive, learns many things fast
Tham Lang.mat_toi: keen at first then bored, can over-indulge
Tham Lang.cau_tu_soi: Of all the things you want, which do you truly need?

Cự Môn.tinh_chat: the Great Gate star: sharp, articulate, questions and analyses to the end
Cự Môn.diem_manh: argument, debate, work that uses words
Cự Môn.mat_toi: suspicious, words can stir trouble, slow to trust
Cự Môn.cau_tu_soi: What is the last thing you said that you regret?

Thiên Tướng.tinh_chat: the Minister star: fair, values courtesy, good at supporting and coordinating
Thiên Tướng.mat_toi: easily swayed, unsure when standing alone
Thiên Tướng.cau_tu_soi: Are you living by your own standards or someone else's?

Thiên Lương.tinh_chat: the Elder star: protective, likes to guide, values doing what is right
Thiên Lương.diem_manh: shelters, advises, stays calm in a crisis
Thiên Lương.mat_toi: lectures, lonely, likes to play the rescuer
Thiên Lương.cau_tu_soi: Do you let others learn their own lessons?

Thất Sát.tinh_chat: the General star: brave, independent, ready to charge ahead and change things
Thất Sát.diem_manh: decisive, handles pressure, opens new paths
Thất Sát.mat_toi: rushes, takes risks, finds long partnerships hard
Thất Sát.cau_tu_soi: The last time you acted too fast, what did you learn?

Phá Quân.tinh_chat: the Breaker star: breaks the old to build the new, loves reform, resists rules
Phá Quân.diem_manh: dares to change, innovates, starts things
Phá Quân.mat_toi: wasteful, impulsive, leaves things half done
Phá Quân.cau_tu_soi: What do you want to break down — and what will you build instead?
